title: Split domains form a covering presieve
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be finite etale [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $W\in X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. The sieve generated by the splitting presieve of [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-trace-splitting-data] is a covering sieve on $W$.

source.place: Section 03SH (section-trace-method), paragraph after Definition 03SE; descent details as in SGA 4, Expose IX, 5.1.

proof.text: Base change f to the finite etale projection W times_X Y -> W. For each point of W apply the local splitting theorem to obtain an etale neighbourhood U -> W, clopen cofan, and isomorphisms of pieces with U.

Regard U as etale over X by composition. Pullback symmetry followed by pasting identifies the local split ambient scheme with U times_X Y. Transport the cofan along this isomorphism and take inverse piece isomorphisms as t_j. This produces explicit splitting data.

The neighbourhood indexed by each point contains a lift of that point. Their arrows are jointly surjective, hence generate a covering sieve. Each belongs to the split presieve, so upward closure of the topology proves the claim. Empty W is handled by the empty indexed family.
